given: a stock record filed with a single combined inventory tracking code (encoding location, batch, and serial together)
then: the record includes the combined inventory code exactly as it was filed

independence.rationale: Adds persistence and read-back of the combined inventory_code, which is separate data from the SKU/location/quantity of AC1: the code can be dropped or corrupted while quantity persists correctly, and vice versa.

architectural_notes: API boundary (app/routes/) file+retrieve round-trip: the combined inventory_code is a persisted column on the Stock model (app/models/stock.py), written verbatim through the service and repository and returned verbatim on read. No parsing/decoding of the code happens in the boundary or the domain — it is stored and echoed as an opaque string, so no business logic leaks into the routes. Cross-cutting concern touched: same boundary input-validation ownership as AC1 (the code field, when required, is validated at the boundary), but this AC's assertion is fidelity of the stored/read-back value, not validation.
